The '''177th Light Infantry Division''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit. A twenty-man squad from the Division was lost during a mission to blow up a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] munitions dump due to faulty intelligence fed to Alliance [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Bonic Tarracus]] known as "Corewatch."
